Content Creator / Branding Officer Job at IfeanHealth Nigeria Limited




        
    

        
        IfeanHealth Nigeria Limited is a purpose-driven organization committed to improving lives through accessible healthcare solutions and community impact initiatives. We are passionate about delivering value and building lasting relationships with our clients and partners. 

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Content Creator / Branding Officer
Job Location: Isolo, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are looking for a creative and results-driven Content Creator / Branding Officer to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for creating engaging content, strengthening our brand identity, and increasing our online presence across digital platforms.
	If you are passionate about storytelling, content creation, branding, and digital marketing, we'd love to hear from you.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and execute creative content strategies aligned with the company's goals.
	Create high-quality content for social media, websites, blogs, email campaigns, and other marketing materials.
	Plan, shoot, and edit engaging photos and videos for digital platforms.
	Design creative graphics, flyers, banners, and promotional materials.
	Manage the company's social media accounts and maintain a consistent brand voice.
	Develop monthly content calendars and marketing campaigns.
	Monitor social media trends and identify opportunities to improve engagement.
	Work closely with different departments to create content for company programs, events, recruitment, and community outreach.
	Ensure all brand materials are consistent with the company's identity and messaging.
	Track content performance and provide reports with recommendations for improvement.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Mass Communication, Media, Branding, Digital Marketing, or a related field.
	Minimum of 2 years of experience in content creation, branding, or digital marketing.
	Strong writing and storytelling skills.
	Proficiency in Canva, Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro), CapCut, or similar creative tools.
	Experience managing social media platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, and X.
	Knowledge of photography, videography, and video editing.
	Excellent communication and organizational skills.
	Ability to work independently, meet deadlines, and think creatively.


What We're Looking For


	Creative thinker with strong attention to detail.
	Excellent visual storytelling skills.
	Self-motivated and proactive.
	Strong time management and multitasking abilities.
	Passion for building impactful brands.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CVs and portfolios to: [email protected] using "Content creator/Branding Officer" as the subject of the email.

title: Job Openings at Schubbs Dental Clinics
content:
Schubbs Dental Clinics is a modern Dental clinic, with branches in Apapa, Ikeja and Ikoyi, that provides excellent dental services.

We are recruiting suitable candidates to fill the following positions below: 

1.) Dentist

Job Location: Lagos 

Responsibilties
     

            
    




	You will examine and diagnose patients, plan treatment, and deliver general dental care: check-ups, scaling and polishing, fillings, crowns, root canal therapy and extractions.
	You will keep accurate records and hold to our infection control and patient safety standards.
	Where a case calls for a specialist, you refer it. You will work alongside the dental surgery assistants and the front desk team, and you are expected to explain every treatment to the patient in plain language before it begins.


Qualifications


	Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS) or an equivalent qualification from a recognized institution.
	Full registration with the Medical and Dental Council of Nigeria (MDCN).
	A valid licence to practise dentistry in Nigeria.
	Completed NYSC, with a valid Discharge Certificate or Exemption Certificate.
	Good communication and interpersonal skills.
	A professional, responsible and compassionate approach to patient care.
	The ability to work with other healthcare professionals.
	Dentists who have recently completed NYSC are welcome to apply.
	Previous clinical experience is an advantage, not a requirement.


Click here to apply online

 

 

2.) Electronics Engineer

Job Location: Lagos 

Responsibilties


	You will test and maintain the electronic systems across all three clinics, diagnose faults and repair equipment.
	You will handle the installation and routine maintenance of biomedical equipment, and write the technical reports that record what was done and what falls due next.
	When a unit goes down, you are the person the clinic calls.


Qualifications


	A Bachelor's Degree in Electronics Engineering or a related field.
	At least two years of relevant experience.
	Not more than 40 years of age.
	Strong knowledge of electronic circuits and fault diagnosis.
	Good communication and teamwork skills.


Click here to apply online

 

3.) Orthodontist

Job Location: Lagos 

Responsibilties


	You will consult, examine and diagnose, then build the treatment plan and see it through, whether the case runs on fixed appliances, aligners or another corrective approach.
	You will review progress at each visit and adjust when a case moves differently to how it was projected.
	Retention and post-treatment follow-up are part of the case, not the end of it. You will explain the treatment, the oral hygiene it demands and the aftercare to every patient, keep records current as you go, and hold to our infection control and patient safety standards.
	Where a case needs a restorative dentist, an oral surgeon or another colleague, you work with them directly.


Qualifications


	Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS) or an equivalent dental qualification from a recognized institution.
	A postgraduate qualification in Orthodontics from a recognized institution.
	Full registration with the Medical and Dental Council of Nigeria (MDCN).
	Completed NYSC, with a valid Discharge Certificate or Exemption Certificate.
	Working knowledge of Invisalign and clear aligner treatment.
	Strong clinical, diagnostic and treatment-planning skills.
	Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
	A professional, patient-focused and compassionate approach to care.
	Experience planning and managing Invisalign cases is an advantage.


Click here to apply online

Accountant Job at  Jobs Expert




        
    

        
         Jobs Expert, a recruitment services firm, is recruiting suitable candidates to fill the position below: 

 Job Position: Accountant

Job Location: Omole Phase 2, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description


	An Accountant is responsible for managing financial records, preparing financial reports, monitoring transactions, ensuring compliance with accounting standards, and supporting the organization’s financial decision-making.


Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Record and maintain accurate financial transactions.
	Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports.
	Manage accounts payable and receivable.
	Prepare bank and other account reconciliations.
	Monitor income, expenses, budgets, and cash flow.
	Prepare invoices and process payments.
	Assist with payroll and tax-related activities.
	Maintain proper financial documentation and records.
	Assist with audits and provide required financial information.
	Ensure compliance with accounting policies, tax regulations, and relevant standards.
	Identify discrepancies and resolve accounting errors.
	Provide management with financial analysis and advice.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s degree or HND in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
	3-5 years of relevant accounting experience, depending on the position.
	Professional accounting qualification (e.g.,ICAN/ACCA) is an advantage.
	Good knowledge of accounting principles and financial reporting.
	Experience using accounting software and Microsoft Excel.
	Understanding of taxation and regulatory requirements.
	Strong numerical and analytical ability.
	Good attention to detail and accuracy.


Important Skills:


	Financial reporting
	Bookkeeping
	Bank reconciliation
	Budgeting and forecasting
	Taxation
	Payroll processing
	Microsoft Excel
	Accounting software
	Data analysis
	Problem-solving
	Attention to detail
	Time management
	Communication and teamwork
	Integrity and confidentiality

SME Loan Officer Job at Baselenders Limited




        
    

        
        Baselenders Limited is a Lagos-based licensed money lender regulated by the Lagos State Government. We provide fast, responsible, and professionally structured credit to SMEs, professionals, and individuals across Lagos State. We are growing our sales team and looking for driven, self-motivated Sales Executives who want to earn well, grow fast, and be part of building something meaningful.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: SME Loan Officer 

Job Location: Ikoyi, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Work Mode: Hybrid

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are looking for smart, energetic, and result-driven Loan Officers to join our growing team.
	If you are passionate about sales, relationship management, and earning based on performance, this opportunity is for you.


Key Responsibilities


	Generate and convert new loan leads through field sales, referrals, and personal networks.
	Market Baselenders’ loan products to prospective customers.
	Guide customers through the loan application process.
	Build and maintain strong customer relationships.
	Monitor customer repayments and support recovery efforts where necessary.
	Meet monthly sales and portfolio performance targets.
	Submit weekly activity and performance reports.


Requirements


	OND, HND, or BSc Degree in any discipline.
	Minimum of 2 years of experience in sales, loan marketing, or financial services.
	Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
	Self-motivated and target-driven.
	Ability to work independently and in the field.
	Basic understanding of loan products and customer risk assessment.


What We Offer


	Competitive base Salary: N150,000 - N200,000 monthly.
	Attractive commission structure with strong earning potential.
	Performance bonuses for maintaining a healthy portfolio.
	Career growth opportunities within the organization.
	Professional work environment in Ikoyi, Lagos.


Method of Applictaion 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.
